stem: In the U.S. free-enterprise system of the early 1800s, how did competition MOST affect the U.S. economy?

options.label: A
options.text: Competition resulted in strict regulation and low taxation of manufactured goods.

options.label: B
options.text: Competition promoted the fair pricing and high quality of goods.

options.label: C
options.text: Competition discouraged businesses and people from using banks.

options.label: D
options.text: Competition decreased exports of raw materials and manufactured goods.
